title: FC Barcelona rejects Revolut as a financial sponsor because Figo is the face of the digital bank
summary: FC Barcelona is looking for a new financial sponsor. CaixaBank has been a long-time sponsor, but it has been over a year since the contract with the Catalan club ended and has not been renewed, although negotiations are open. Meanwhile, in recent months, Barça had considered the possibility of incorporating the digital bank Revolut as a new sponsor. As explained in the Catalunya Ràdio podcast "Barça reservat", the club ultimately ended up ruling it out for sentimental, rather than economic, reasons. Former Barça player Luís Figo is the face of the digital bank's new campaign . And not only that, the Portuguese even makes some reference, in the spots, to his transfer to Madrid in 2000. This did not please FC Barcelona at all, who ended up rejecting Revolut's proposal . submitted by /u/Status-Sample-218 [link] [comments]
